create.name: Bob Stahl
create.bio:
Bob Stahl is a mindfulness and insight meditation teacher whose path began with more than eight years as a resident of a Burmese Buddhist monastery in the forest lineage of the Venerable Taungpulu Sayadaw. After leaving monastic life he became one of the early teachers of mindfulness-based stress reduction, setting up in 1991 what is described as the first MBSR programme in California and running it at hospitals around the San Francisco Bay Area for some thirty years. He has taught as a senior teacher for the Center for Mindfulness at UMass Medical School, and holds a professor-of-the-practice post at Brown University's School of Public Health, and teaches at the university's mindfulness centre as one of its senior staff.

Today, with his wife Jan Landry, he concentrates on retreats, classes and online mentoring. He leads residential and online mindfulness retreats in many countries, is co-guiding teacher of Insight Santa Cruz, and has taught at IMS and the Barre Center for Buddhist Studies. His teaching keeps the Buddhist roots of mindfulness close, with attention to the body, lovingkindness and reflection on impermanence, alongside gentle mindful yoga and qigong. He has co-written several books, including MBSR Every Day with Elisha Goldstein and Living with Your Heart Wide Open with Steve Flowers.

books.title: MBSR Every Day: Daily Practices from the Heart of Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction
books.author: Elisha Goldstein, Bob Stahl
books.description: A follow-on to the authors' MBSR workbook, made up of short daily practices and reflections for bringing mindful attention into ordinary routines. It is designed to be dipped into rather than read straight through.

books.title: Living with Your Heart Wide Open: How Mindfulness and Compassion Can Free You from Unworthiness, Inadequacy, and Shame
books.author: Steve Flowers, Bob Stahl
books.description: A guide to meeting harsh self-judgement with mindfulness and self-compassion, drawing on Buddhist teaching and Western psychology. It includes guided lovingkindness and compassion practices for opening the heart towards oneself and others.

courses.title: Mindfulness as the Gateway to Many Beautiful Qualities
courses.description: An IMS Online retreat over five days, taught with Éowyn Ahlstrom, with silent sitting and walking, guided movement and dharma talks. It explores how sustained mindfulness gives rise to kindness, compassion, joy and equanimity, and it counts as a retreat prerequisite for some MBSR and MBCT teacher trainings.

courses.title: Online Mindful Mentoring
courses.description: Online sessions with Bob Stahl or Jan Landry, for individuals or groups, offering personal guidance in starting, deepening or applying a mindfulness practice in work and daily life.

courses.title: Qigong and Lovingkindness Meditation Video
courses.description: A downloadable video of a thirty-minute guided mindful qigong session followed by a thirty-minute lovingkindness meditation.

courses.title: MBSR Audio Downloads
courses.description: Guided MP3 practices from the MBSR curriculum, including a body scan with sitting meditation and gentle lying and standing mindful yoga.

free_resources.title: Dharma Talks on Dharma Seed
free_resources.description: Bob's archive of retreat talks and guided meditations, free to stream or download.
